name: photon-mixer
description: Digital-native illustration software with float32 linear color and GPU-native architecture
author: iwabuchi404

scripts.build: tsc && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path shaders -Destination dist -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path electron/preload.cjs -Destination dist/electron -Force"
scripts.dev: tsc && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path shaders -Destination dist -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path electron/preload.cjs -Destination dist/electron -Force" && cross-env PM_DEV=1 electron .
